CustomField.description: Overall MEDDPICC deal qualification score from 0-100. Calculated as the average of all 8 MEDDPICC criteria scores, weighted equally. Score of 100 means all criteria rated "5 - Very Strong". Blank scores count as 0.
CustomField.formula: ( (CASE(TEXT(MEDDPICC_Metrics_Score__c), "1 - Very Weak", 1, "2 - Weak", 2, "3 - Moderate", 3, "4 - Strong", 4, "5 - Very Strong", 5, 0) + CASE(TEXT(MEDDPICC_Economic_Buyer_Score__c), "1 - Very Weak", 1, "2 - Weak", 2, "3 - Moderate", 3, "4 - Strong", 4, "5 - Very Strong", 5, 0) + CASE(TEXT(MEDDPICC_Decision_Criteria_Score__c), "1 - Very Weak", 1, "2 - Weak", 2, "3 - Moderate", 3, "4 - Strong", 4, "5 - Very Strong", 5, 0) + CASE(TEXT(MEDDPICC_Decision_Process_Score__c), "1 - Very Weak", 1, "2 - Weak", 2, "3 - Moderate", 3, "4 - Strong", 4, "5 - Very Strong", 5, 0) + CASE(TEXT(MEDDPICC_Paper_Process_Score__c), "1 - Very Weak", 1, "2 - Weak", 2, "3 - Moderate", 3, "4 - Strong", 4, "5 - Very Strong", 5, 0) + CASE(TEXT(MEDDPICC_Identify_Pain_Score__c), "1 - Very Weak", 1, "2 - Weak", 2, "3 - Moderate", 3, "4 - Strong", 4, "5 - Very Strong", 5, 0) + CASE(TEXT(MEDDPICC_Champion_Score__c), "1 - Very Weak", 1, "2 - Weak", 2, "3 - Moderate", 3, "4 - Strong", 4, "5 - Very Strong", 5, 0) + CASE(TEXT(MEDDPICC_Competition_Score__c), "1 - Very Weak", 1, "2 - Weak", 2, "3 - Moderate", 3, "4 - Strong", 4, "5 - Very Strong", 5, 0) ) / 40 ) * 100
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Overall deal qualification score (0-100) based on all MEDDPICC criteria. 100 = fully qualified, 0 = not assessed.
CustomField.label: Deal Qualification Score
